question: **Choose the incorrectly spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is option 4), i.e., "Consumate." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling is '**C****onsummate**.' • 'Consummate' means 'showing a high degree of skill and flair; complete or perfect.' (परिपूर्ण) • Example: • *He won the race with **consummate** ease.* • Therefore, 'Consumate' is incorrectly spelt among the given options. • Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let's know the meaning of the other options: Word Meaning Professional elating to or belonging to a profession; engaged in a specified activity as one's main paid occupation. (पेशेवर) Dubious hesitating or doubting; not to be relied upon; suspect. (संदिग्ध, अनिश्चित, अविश्वसनीय) Nefarious (typically of an action or activity) wicked or criminal. (कुटिल, बेईमान) 3b:T1b4a,
